intro: First Kings begins with Israel at its height, and ends with it split in two.
Chapters one to eleven: King Solomon, his wisdom, and the building of the temple in Jerusalem. Chapters twelve to sixteen: the kingdom divides, into Israel in the north and Judah in the south.
Chapters seventeen to twenty-two: the prophet Elijah stands against King Ahab and the worship of Baal.
Its author isn't named; tradition credits Jeremiah.
Listen for what happens when hearts turn away from God, and for the still small voice.
